newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading of Dah Bang shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Dah Bang shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of printing machinery distributor Dah Bang (Holdings) Ltd was suspended on Friday pending an announcement, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said.

The printing machinery distributor said in a statement published on Friday that a third party would be required to make a general offer for the company shares and warrants on completion of purchase of a controlling stake in the company.
"The third party has started due diligence exercise on the company," Dah Bang said.
"Both parties have agreed to maintain confidentially regarding the details of the proposed sale of interests until a binding agreement is to be reached," it said.
In July, the company said its chairman Chen Da Yun, and directors Chen Chung Man Shun and Paul Chen were in talks with a third party to sell their stake, which might lead to a general offer.
The three directors hold a total 72.86 percent of Dah Bang share capital and 72.49 percent of the outstanding warrants.
